title: Blog post, front-loaded modular engine
description: Three mandatory layers for Israeli founders entering the US market. Layer 1 (executive_summary + primary_cta) serves the reader who bounces in 30 seconds. Layer 2 (decision_matrix) is the scannable break. Layer 3 (deep_context_body) is the citation fuel. There is deliberately NO intro field and additionalProperties is false everywhere, which is what stops a model defaulting to preamble.

updated_at.description: Refresh inside three months or citation rates decay.

source_log.description: Seed file this was generated from.

direct_answer.description: 40 to 60 words answering the core problem. The solution must land in the first two sentences. No background, no history, no 'In today's landscape'.

cta_id.description: Selects a pre-built offer from packages/2nd-brain/data/cta-library.json. The model emits the id only and never writes CTA copy. This removes a hallucination surface, cuts output tokens, and means editing the offer once updates every post on the next render.

decision_matrix.description: LAYER 2. Plain English breakdown of costs, timelines, or requirements. Table or bullets, not both.

deep_context_body.description: LAYER 3. 800+ words minimum, 2,900+ for a pillar. Six sections at 130 to 180 words clears 800; a pillar needs roughly 16 to 20.

content.description: Markdown. Open with a direct two to three sentence answer to the H2, then the Federal and State regulatory specifics. Roughly 130 to 180 words. No wind-up.

authorities.description: REQUIRED, and the whole reason layer 3 exists. Named agencies, form numbers, statutes, deadlines, or fees. A section with no verifiable specific is not citable and should be cut.

name.description: For example 'USCIS Form I-129' or 'Delaware Division of Corporations'.

faq_schema_items.description: Emitted as FAQPage JSON-LD. Engines quote these verbatim.

answer.description: Direct two sentence plain English answer.

allOf.$comment: State must be capitalized when used as the government adjective. The verb 'to state' is left alone deliberately.
Must end in a question mark.
